invariants.hydraulic_owner: Soil-water owner. Compensation does not acquire HeadCalc/Newton/Jacobian ownership.
invariants.stress_owner: Drought/oxygen/salinity/frost modifiers remain independently qualified inputs/results. Compensation does not admit them.
invariants.crop_owner: Root geometry and crop/root-development quantities remain crop/root owner inputs.
invariants.transaction: A compensated trial must be derived from the same committed/root-demand checkpoint as its uncompensated candidate. Rejected compensated output is disposable.
invariants.retry: A smaller retry must rebuild the pre-compensation root result from the committed checkpoint; it may not rescale an already-scaled rejected qrot.
invariants.restart: UNKNOWN_DO_NOT_INFER until exact B1.11 source trace proves whether compensation owns continuation state.
invariants.reporting: Stress-attribution totals are diagnostics/results unless exact source establishes continuation semantics.
invariants.coupling: Any compensation-induced change in root sink remains outside analytic groundwater tangent coverage until root-response derivative coverage is separately admitted.
